summary: Verified the P0 RiskDetailModal crash fix. The Deep Dive modal now opens without any ReferenceError (CONN_TONE / deriveConnectors are now defined) across every dashboard that uses it. Verified all 6 required sections render (Risk & Rating scores, Connectors & data sources with LIVE health color coding, AI Strategic Brief/Insight, Recommendations & fixes, facets grid, compliance alignment). Tested on: (a) AI Executive Overview (overview-agent-AGT-002, overview-toxic-combos, overview-shadow-SHAI-LLM-anthropic), (b) Agentic AI Security dashboard – Mission Control card (mc-agent-AGT-002), (c) Agentic AI Security – Agent Inventory sub-tab (inventory-agent-AGT-002). Zero console errors captured during the run. standard-actions block renders inside the modal for the admin account on agent items. No `overview-incident-*` row was present in the seeded data (Open AI incidents = 0 on the exec overview), so the incident path could not be exercised end-to-end in the UI – but the modal is source-agnostic so the same code path applies. Routes referenced in the request (/agents, /toxicity, /assets, /governance, /remediations) do not exist as top-level routes in this app; those views are actually rendered as tabs inside /app/agentic-ai-security (agentic-tab-inventory / -shadow / -incidents / -authority / -guardrails) which were all reachable and the Deep Dive modal opened correctly from them.

integration_issues.issue: ca-recent-0 / ca-recent-1 rows do not open a Deep Dive modal on click (no-op). Low-priority polish – not a regression of the P0 fix.

critical_code_review_comments: RiskDetailModal.jsx (313 lines) — CONN_TONE + deriveConnectors helpers are correctly defined at the top of the file (lines 11-42). Connector chips derive live health tone from CONN_TONE and gracefully fall back to neutral grey when status is unknown. Fallback derivation from provider/sources/tools/resources means EVERY item, even without an explicit connectors[] array, shows a Connectors & data sources section — matches the user's explicit requirement.

All 6 required sections are wrapped by data-testids (deep-dive-scores, deep-dive-connectors + deep-dive-connector-<i>, deep-dive-recommendations, deep-dive-facets, deep-dive-compliance, plus AIExplain block) — great testability.
AIExplain uses kind='deep-dive' with the item's own explainContext — renders live and did not throw during the run.

rca of the issue: Previous iteration referenced deriveConnectors() and CONN_TONE inside the RiskDetailModal Connectors block but never declared them (they were removed/refactored out) -> ReferenceError on modal mount -> Deep Dive card crashed on every dashboard that used it. Fix (already applied by main agent): declared CONN_TONE status->HSL map and deriveConnectors(item) helper at top of RiskDetailModal.jsx that prefers item.connectors and otherwise derives from provider/sources/tools/resources so EVERY detail card renders a Connectors & data sources section, with live health colors when status is present. Verified: modal opens, no ReferenceError, all 6 sections render across multiple dashboards, connector chips show live health colors.
